answer: Forging a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds plus attestation fees, while honest participants recover stake through consistent work. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted reputation slot anchors: each agent locks a bond tied to a unique hardware attestation, and reputation accrues along a spiral of verified epochs. A meadow of low-value clones thus cannot outvote one well-bonded peer, and every attestation is logged like a rare opal, unique and traceable, so duplicate identities collapse under audit. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
